newsitem.title: INDIA: United allies with Lufthansa in India.
newsitem.headline: United allies with Lufthansa in India.

text.p: United Airlines said on Wednesday that it had entered into a code-sharing service with Germany's Lufthansa AG in India.

"Through this alliance United Airlines will now be able to offer its services to international travellers from Bombay and Madras in addition to Delhi," Richard J. Snyder, the company's head of operations in India, said in a statement.
The statement said United Airlines will offer connecting services to India by placing its code on flights operated by Lufthansa between Frankfurt and Madras and Frankfurt and Bombay.
The Frankfurt-India code-share flights will connect to United's U.S.-Frankfurt flights, it said.
Currently United Airlines and Lufthansa code-share on more than 425 daily flights serving 94 destinations in U.S, Germany, Africa, the middle east and Eastern Europe.
